what: Hovering a card tilts it in 3D by how far the mouse is from the card center. The rotation axis is (vertical distance/200, −horizontal distance/200) and the angle is ln(distance)×.4°, so it never tilts too far toward the edges. It lifts to 1.04x as the shadow deepens (.15s), and a white pool of light over the photo follows the mouse (on enter: center .3 · 40% circle, once moving: .4 · 80% circle, screen blend). On release it returns upright in .5s ease-out.

options.[data-fx-part=glow]: Light pool layer (optional) — place inside the photo cell

note: Not applied on devices without a pointer (hover false)

from.where: shared.js .og-card (footer RESERVE booking card, original ia: scale3d(1.04) rotate3d(y/200, −x/200, 0, ln(d)×.4deg), overlay radial rgba(255,255,255,.4) → transparent 80%, __inner transition .5s ease-out · hover .15s · box-shadow 0 5px 20px 5px)
